items.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
items.excerpt: President Trump said US companies building AI data centers abroad would face a 'tremendous tax' (BBC reports he floated a ban), adding he had not yet run the idea by his staff. AI geopolitics / datacenter siting; statement, no formal order yet.

items.title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China
items.excerpt: California's attorney general has opened an investigation and subpoenaed Nvidia over whether its AI chips were diverted to China and whether the company misled investors, saying the Megaspeed scandal 'raises bright red flags'. New state-level formal action in the chip-export story.

items.title: Probe opened over Nvidia influence on US government
items.excerpt: US representatives sent a letter dated Thursday to Commerce Secretary Lutnick opening a probe into whether Nvidia was allowed to interfere with Commerce's investigation of Megaspeed over possible illegal diversion of AI chips to China (Reuters). Formal congressional action, distinct from the 879k-license disclosure.

items.title: 베선트 "미중 정상, AI 군사 결정에 인간 개입 합의"
items.excerpt: 스콧 베선트 미 재무장관이 CNBC 인터뷰에서 트럼프 대통령과 시진핑 주석이 AI(슈퍼지능)를 활용한 모든 군사적 결정에 항상 인간이 개입해야 하며 주요 군사작전에서 자율 작동을 허용하지 않기로 합의했다고 밝혔다. 서명된 공동성명 텍스트는 아직 없음 — 공식 발언 기준.

items.title: AI 데이터센터 구축 문턱 낮아진다…업계 기대 속 남은 과제는
items.excerpt: 과학기술정보통신부가 20일 AIDC 특별법 하위법령 제정안과 전력계통영향평가 개선 방안을 발표했다 — 비수도권 50MW 이하 AI 데이터센터 전력평가 면제, 인허가 일괄처리·대규모 사업 패스트트랙 등. (정책브리핑 korea.kr·전자신문 동일 발표)

items.title: Policies on the Use of Generative Super Intelligence in Agency Adjudication; Request for Comments
items.excerpt: The Administrative Conference of the United States requests public comment on policies for use of generative AI ('generative super intelligence') by agency adjudicators, staff, parties and representatives in federal agency adjudications; responses feed an ACUS best-practice recommendation. Primary document; FR publication date 2026-11-19 (no time given).

items.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) in social care
items.excerpt: UK government publishes non-statutory guidance on the use of artificial intelligence in children's and adults' social care in England. Primary document.

items.title: Senators criticize Apple and Google for letting teens access ‘nudify’ apps despite parental controls
items.excerpt: Three Senate Democrats sent letters to Apple and Google CEOs saying app-store safeguards against AI 'nudification' apps are insufficient and teens can still reach them despite parental controls.

items.title: European Commission scrambles to contain AI-assisted cyberattack
items.excerpt: The European Commission confirmed attackers used an AI tool in a cyberattack that took staff HR and medical-reimbursement systems offline; officials are investigating whether personal data was compromised.

items.title: China attackers deployed AI agents that autonomously found and exploited a 0-day to take over a university server
items.excerpt: Amazon CISO CJ Moses says suspected Chinese state-linked attackers used the open-source Cairn AI agent framework to autonomously find and exploit a zero-day in MONAI Label and seize a university server, adapting for nearly a day without human direction. Vendor threat report, not a government action.

items.title: 2026 Elections: Taiwan tells Meta of China accounts to influence polls
items.excerpt: Taiwan flagged nearly 2,700 Threads accounts to Meta as a suspected Chinese influence campaign before the Nov. 28 local elections; internal reports say ~260 accounts spread 2,150+ AI-generated videos with 2.35M interactions. Meta says many were already disabled. Check vs taiwan-cib-election-deepfake (11-13).
